preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 16 prescribes the three pilgrimage festivals (Passover, Weeks, Booths) and the appointment of judges. No substantial Cave 4 or Cave 1 manuscript preserves this chapter; coverage is essentially absent.
preamble.notable_variants: No DSS variants documented for this chapter beyond passing references.
preamble.scroll_condition: No substantial Qumran attestation. The reconstructed text is therefore the MT.
